---
title: Capstone — End-to-End Preprocessing Pipeline
---

## Specification

Build a reproducible pipeline that takes a directory of raw fundus images (mixed JPEG/TIFF) and produces a standardized output:

1. Load each image, convert to RGB if needed.
2. Apply CLAHE (clipLimit=2.0, tileGridSize=(8,8)).
3. Optionally convert to LAB and use L channel for further processing.
4. Save the processed image as PNG in an output directory, preserving the base filename.

The pipeline must be scripted (`pipeline.py`) and include a `README` explaining usage and dependencies.

## Acceptance rubric

- [ ] Script runs without errors on a test set of 10 images.
- [ ] Output images are visually comparable (no color shifts, no artifacts).
- [ ] All output files are PNG with consistent bit depth.
- [ ] Pipeline logs each step (input filename, output filename, any warnings).
- [ ] No PHI is included in the output (filenames only, no embedded metadata).
